result.answer:
The original plan (80e55dc2) failed because `gram`, `meta`, and `complete` are only valid when `annotator` is `'bakta'` — but the default annotator is Prokka. I've created a **corrected plan** with those parameters removed:

---

### Corrected plan `b6904b2f7fd74bf1a4ac3f2f1f5bee33`

| Change | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `gram` | `"+"` | removed (Bakta-only) |
| `complete` | `false` | removed (Bakta-only) |
| `genus` | `Example` | unchanged |
| `species` | `syntheticum` | unchanged |
| `prefix` | `example_annot` | unchanged |
| `cpus` | `2` | unchanged |
| `rfam` | `false` | unchanged |

**Engine:** shell (the Cromwell backend note does not apply to shell pipelines)

**To run:** `agent-pipeline run --plan-id b6904b2f7fd74bf1a4ac3f2f1f5bee33`

This is a new plan ID, so I need your approval before executing it. Shall I proceed?
